Talent0_2Ability.name: 第三适格者
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 与机兵可以进行<buf ID=900088>[同步]</buf>；主动攻击后，若自身携带的增益效果大于等于<color=#F74848>3</color>个，可发动<buf ID=900004>[再攻击]</buf>，攻击前无法移动，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次

Talent3_5Ability.name: 第三适格者
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
与机兵可以进行<buf ID=900088>[同步]</buf>；主动攻击后，若自身携带的增益效果大于等于<color=#F74848>3</color>个，可发动<buf ID=900004>[再攻击]</buf>，攻击前无法移动，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次；
出击时，<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>提升<color=#F74848>10%</color>；行动开始时，若[零]或[明日香]在场，随机获得<color=#F74848>1</color>个增益效果，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201402.name: 穿透狙击
201402.describe: 使用狙击步枪攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.1</color>倍伤害，本次攻击无视目标任何减伤效果，攻击前可以进行<buf ID=900014>[瞄准]</buf>

201403.name: 稳态作战
201403.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击对战时，若目标周围<color=#F74848>2</color>格范围内没有其他敌机，伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>

201404.name: 压制扫射
201404.describe: 使用重机枪攻击<range type=1>直线3格</range>范围内所有目标，造成<color=#F74848>0.7</color>倍范围伤害，每命中<color=#F74848>1</color>个目标，战后获得<color=#F74848>1</color>个随机增益效果，最多获得<color=#F74848>3</color>个，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

201405.name: 不溃
201405.SpecificEffects: 免疫<buf ID=7101505>[宕机]</buf>和<buf ID=900035>[胆怯]</buf>效果

201406.name: 高能射击
201406.describe: 使用狙击步枪攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.5</color>倍伤害，攻击前可以进行<buf ID=900014>[瞄准]</buf>，本次攻击无视目标任何减伤效果；若<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>大于等于<color=#F74848>75%</color>时，本次攻击必定命中

201407.name: 超限模式
201407.SpecificEffects: 行动开始时，若自身携带的增益效果大于等于<color=#F74848>4</color>个，本回合第<color=#F74848>1</color>次主动攻击AP消耗<color=#F74848>-1</color>，最低<color=#F74848>1</color>点

201408.name: 动能焕发
201408.describe: 消耗所有可驱散的增益效果，每消耗<color=#F74848>1</color>个回复<color=#F74848>1</color>点AP，最多回复<color=#F74848>4</color>点，然后可使用剩余移动力继续行动

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201431.name: 过载模式1
201431.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>大于等于<color=#F74848>65%</color>时，伤害提升<color=#F74848>10%</color>，遭受伤害降低<color=#F74848>10%</color>

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

201434.name: 过载模式2
201434.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击对战后，随机复制<color=#F74848>1</color>个目标携带的可驱散的增益效果，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>2</color>次

201435.name: 过载模式3
201435.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>大于等于<color=#F74848>80%</color>时，行动结束时每有<color=#F74848>1</color>个增益效果恢复自身<color=#F74848>5%</color>最大耐久值，最多恢复<color=#F74848>15%</color>，无法修复损毁部位

201436.name: 过载模式4
201436.SpecificEffects:
<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>上限突破至<color=#F74848>400%</color>，超过<color=#F74848>100%</color>的部分效果降低<color=#F74848>50%</color>；
<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>大于等于<color=#F74848>100%</color>时，暴击率提升<color=#F74848>30%</color>，移动力<color=#F74848>+1</color>；
自身耐久值低于<color=#F74848>20%</color>时，<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>立即增加<color=#F74848>50%</color>，该效果每次出击仅可发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次

201441.name: 拟合重组1
201441.SpecificEffects: 手臂的耐久值和护甲值提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

201444.name: 拟合重组2
201444.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击对战时，若目标无法反击，战后随机延长自身<color=#F74848>1</color>个增益效果的<buf ID=900078>[剩余回合]</buf><color=#F74848>1</color>回合

201445.name: 拟合重组3
201445.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>修正效果增加<color=#F74848>50%</color>，到达<color=#F74848>100%</color>时将固定

201446.name: 拟合重组4
201446.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>到达<color=#F74848>100%</color>时，重机枪和狙击步枪射程<color=#F74848>+1</color>，最终伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>
